serving_note: Served via Ollama (model 'omnecor-valet-router:v2-q8', Q8_0 GGUF). Ollama is used because this box is Sandy Bridge (AVX1-only): prebuilt llama-cpp-python wheels need AVX2 and crash, and transformers serving is ~30s/route here. Ollama warm routing is ~2-3s. The merged_16bit dir remains for re-export.

eval_scores.source: VERIFIED — independent Kaggle eval kernel 'valet-router-eval' (2026-06-11), self-computed on 390 balanced route examples (30 x 13 categories) using exact training-format prompts from eval.jsonl.
eval_scores.caveats: 0.7385 is stable & reproducible: a re-run with max_new_tokens raised 200->350 gave IDENTICAL results (greedy decoding is deterministic), which proves the ~10% 'parse_error' rows are genuine non-JSON model outputs, NOT truncation. Below the valet.config.json 0.85 gate but beats keyword baseline ~2.7x — acceptable for a built-in default router. Weakest buckets: reporting (0.27), knowledge_retrieval (0.53, confused w/ research), local_task (0.57), memory_operations (0.67). Strongest: hardware (1.0), code_generation (0.97), code_review (0.97).

unverified_prior_claim.note: Hardcoded in the valet-v2-eval-run conversion kernel's manifest; NOT reproducible — the independent recompute above gave 0.7385. Treat 0.8949 as unverified.
